scenes.narration: Nike has its own stores and its own app. So why does most of its money come from other stores?
Nike Direct, its own stores and website, brought in 17.7 billion. That fell 6 percent, while selling to other stores grew 6.
Total revenue was 46.4 billion dollars, flat from the year before.
In the last quarter, wholesale grew 4 percent, while Nike Direct fell 7.
About 59 percent of Nike's revenue comes from selling to other retailers.
